key_terms.أَمَّ: He led / He was an imam

ai.seo_question: What is the penalty for the combatant who repents after a year, and what happens if he leads in the land of polytheism?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi clarifies the duration and conditions of the hadd punishment for the combatant (al-Muqatilah), specifying a one-year term that may be shortened if the offender repents and remains humble. It further establishes a critical legal distinction: if the individual leads prayer in the 'land of polytheism' (Ard al-Shirk) or enters it in a leadership capacity, the ruling is execution, reflecting the severity of apostasy or high treason in Shia jurisprudence. The chain of transmission highlights the reliability of the Imams' teachings through the network of their companions.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Muhammad Bin Suleyman, from Ubeydullah Bin Is’haq,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, similar to it, except that he<sup>asws</sup> said at the end of it: ‘That would be done with him for a year. So if he were to repent before that, he would be belittled’. I said, ‘If he were to enters the land of the Ploytheism?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He would be killed’.
